G6_execution_requirements.evidence: Frozen G6 matrix, source/output hash manifest, exact command/JUnit/log inventory and independent review record.
G6_execution_requirements.expected_result: G6 can pass only as regression verification of the implemented local slice; it cannot upgrade unimplemented OpenAPI endpoints or mark original AT cases complete.
G6_execution_requirements.method: Capture candidate before/after source and build hashes; run relevant pytest suites, full Node suite and build/plugin checks under the approved command deadlines; inspect route-level DTO/authority evidence and conditional browser omission criteria from B02-IDENTITY.md. The G6 ledger must compare exact collected test IDs, not only totals, and pin all ten build/native-plugin outputs.
G6_execution_requirements.pass_criteria: Zero unexpected test failures/skips, required source/upload bytes unchanged, output/source fingerprints match the reviewed candidate, no hidden mutation or unlogged scope change, and limitations stay explicit.
G6_execution_requirements.purpose: Validate an immutable candidate against all required existing suites and original API/AT boundaries.
G6_execution_requirements.recovery: Any source/lock/output/test inventory drift creates a new candidate; preserve failed evidence, reassess impact, and rerun affected stages plus G6.
G6_execution_requirements.scope_impact: B03-B13, remaining AT-21 assets, all original AT-01..AT-32, real corporate SSO and production environment acceptance remain tracked outside this local gate.
G6_execution_requirements.target: Original source inventory (17 imported files and ZIP/DOCX), protected sources, lockfiles, Python APIs, Node adapter contracts, build and native plugin outputs.
G6_execution_requirements.tc_owner: TC authors tests and evidence; main integrates/runs the fixed candidate; independent reviewer checks source, counts, artifacts and AT mapping.

route_matrix.expected_result: Login issues no application job; only a short-lived browser transaction is created. Corporate IdP/TLS/proxy is explicitly outside local acceptance.
route_matrix.method: Synthetic provider and real local Uvicorn; validate PKCE S256, state/nonce/browser binding, exact issuer endpoints, secure cookies, errors and query-canary absence.
route_matrix.pass_criteria: G3 report has 114 Python cases with zero failures/errors/skips, real local service exits cleanly, callback canaries absent from logs, and source hash matches the report.
route_matrix.purpose: Create a browser-bound OIDC authorization request.
route_matrix.recovery: Preserve failed Uvicorn/private logs and the exact G3 source candidate; fix auth behavior before continuing to route regression checks.
route_matrix.scope_impact: Synthetic/local authentication evidence only; does not satisfy corporate SSO or original AT-21 alone.
route_matrix.target: Supplemental authentication route; not part of the original OpenAPI job surface.
route_matrix.tc_owner: TC-owned G3 tests; independent reviewer audits the accepted evidence.

route_matrix.expected_result: Browser cookie contains only opaque session material and stable CSRF companion; provider tokens and callback code do not enter DTO/log output.
route_matrix.method: Fixed synthetic issuer, signed JWT claim/key oracle, callback replay/race/expiry matrices, controlled provider failures, real local callback and log canaries.
route_matrix.pass_criteria: Only valid iss/aud/azp/nonce/signature/expiry/state/PKCE creates a session; replay, malformed callback, provider failure and expired state fail closed; no callback secrets leak.
route_matrix.purpose: Validate OIDC code/state/token and create an opaque local session.
route_matrix.recovery: Keep a failed callback transcript in private evidence, ensure canary values are excluded from promoted artifacts, and rerun all G3 auth cases after a semantic fix.
route_matrix.scope_impact: No actual corporate provider or user directory is used.

route_matrix.expected_result: A and B browser sessions remain distinct; no user-supplied identity header is an authorization source.
route_matrix.method: Two isolated clients, idle/absolute expiry boundaries, restart-stable CSRF, rotation/logout, duplicate/spoofed headers, exact Origin/CORS and cookie metadata.
route_matrix.pass_criteria: Invalid/expired/revoked sessions fail; exact Origin+CSRF required for logout; spoofed actor headers never change cookie identity; logout revokes and clears cookie.
route_matrix.purpose: Expose current authenticated identity/CSRF and revoke the session.
route_matrix.recovery: Preserve the failed request/cookie metadata without cookie values; rerun G3 and affected G4 authorization/session tests.
route_matrix.scope_impact: Synthetic identity and local browser origins do not prove deployed identity lifecycle.
route_matrix.target: Supplemental session routes consumed by the local UI.

route_matrix.expected_result: A new job is persisted as DRAFT/accepted, with workflow_id pinned to `ifpmic-sw-v1`; outbox/intent is pending/reserved. G5 may later make workspace READY, but neither event applies the command.
route_matrix.method: Validate exact request DTO/enums/size/depth/scalars, profile snapshot binding, membership/eligibility, input artifacts, idempotency, independent process races, rollback/ack loss, then GET receipt and rows to prove atomic persistence. Cross-reference workspace preparation separately.
route_matrix.pass_criteria: 202 exactly matches CommandReceipt; one durable semantic job/accepted command/outbox/intent group; same key+body replays original receipt; conflicting body is 409; rejected requests create zero group rows; no test infers worker execution from accepted.
route_matrix.purpose: Create an immutable accepted job/command/outbox/workspace-intent group from an authenticated user request.
route_matrix.recovery: Retain the exact candidate, DB lifecycle and private JUnit; repair the transactional/API layer and rerun G4 plus G5 where job intent/acceptance is affected.
route_matrix.scope_impact: B03 outbox dispatch/Temporal worker execution is absent. 202 is acceptance only.
route_matrix.target: Original OpenAPI CreateJob request and CommandReceipt 202 response.
route_matrix.tc_owner: TC-owned G4/G5 tests; original API schema comparison by independent reviewer.

route_matrix.expected_result: No global listing or owner/project spoofing; next_cursor is null at end.
route_matrix.method: Literal 25-item default, descending deterministic order, complete cursor traversal, malformed/noncanonical/scope-tampered cursor rejection, session/membership recheck between pages.
route_matrix.pass_criteria: Only authorized rows are returned; every page is bounded and ordered; valid cursor produces no duplicates/gaps; invalid/foreign cursor is rejected with fixed error; revoked membership denies later page.
route_matrix.purpose: List only jobs visible to the authenticated actor, using signed stable pagination.
route_matrix.recovery: Preserve original page/cursor evidence privately; fix query/authorization semantics, then rerun all G4 pagination and authorization cases.
route_matrix.scope_impact: No event stream or notification feed is implied by the job list.
route_matrix.target: Original OpenAPI JobList DTO with items and next_cursor.

route_matrix.expected_result: Snapshot is a persisted state projection, not evidence of a running workflow; raw configuration bytes are not exposed.
route_matrix.method: Compare exact required fields/types against OpenAPI; test owner, nonmember, delegated read, expired/revoked delegate, malformed/missing IDs and cross-user/project direct URL; verify no private profile/raw logs/provider tokens are included.
route_matrix.pass_criteria: 200 DTO matches schema for authorized reader; 403/404 policy is fixed for foreign/missing resources; unauthorized response contains no target details; owner/project are server-derived.
route_matrix.purpose: Return the authorized public job snapshot and steps DTO.
route_matrix.recovery: Keep the failing DTO/authorization sample private and rerun G4 auth/DTO plus G5 cross-project workspace tests after correction.
route_matrix.scope_impact: Step details currently reflect stored/mock data; no live event or artifact content API is supplied.
route_matrix.tc_owner: TC-owned G4 tests, with B01 safe projection regression.

route_matrix.expected_result: No test maps accepted to applied or reports workflow execution from receipt/workspace readiness.
route_matrix.method: Compare exact DTO and GET authorization for owner, nonmember, delegate, expired/revoked delegate; inspect durable receipt after idempotent replay and uncertain commit.
route_matrix.pass_criteria: Newly accepted command remains `accepted` with null applied_revision until a real consumer applies it; foreign actor cannot fetch it; idempotent replay returns original command ID/status.
route_matrix.purpose: Expose accepted command status to an authorized actor.
route_matrix.recovery: Rerun G4 receipt, authorization, idempotency and commit-uncertainty tests; keep accepted/consumer-applied states distinct.
route_matrix.scope_impact: No command consumer exists under B03, so applied/rejected transition behavior is not accepted end-to-end.
route_matrix.target: Original OpenAPI CommandStatus DTO with accepted/applied/rejected, nullable applied_revision and error.

route_matrix.expected_result: Workspace READY means provisioned, not built or executed; no job logs or image contents are served by a route.
route_matrix.method: Real PostgreSQL 18.1 and POSIX filesystem; two users/projects, concurrent claims, per-job marker/children, symlink/FIFO, crash/retry and direct cross-job read denial.
route_matrix.pass_criteria: Distinct per-job UUID directories and markers, no path sharing/overwrite/deletion; only validated intent reaches READY; accepted G4 semantic rows unchanged.
route_matrix.purpose: Ensure separate durable filesystem paths for different accepted jobs without claiming execution.
route_matrix.recovery: Preserve path/marker/fault evidence and intent state; correct workspace state machine and rerun affected G5 plus G4 acceptance integrity checks.
route_matrix.route: Private workspace lifecycle (not an OpenAPI route)
route_matrix.scope_impact: No build process, worktree ownership, log service, artifact transfer, device access, or B03 worker is exercised.
route_matrix.target: G5 workspace service contract; related to AT-21 path separation only.
route_matrix.tc_owner: TC-owned G5 suite and independent final review.

current_partial_evidence: G3 establishes synthetic two-session authentication, cookie/session isolation and session expiry/revocation controls.
G4 proves two actors cannot read each other's job/command and cross-project reads are denied, including independent sessions/process races.
G5 proves accepted jobs for different users/projects receive separate workspace identities and filesystem paths, and cross-job HTTP reads are forbidden.
AT21.original_then: 서버 권한 검사로 거절; 파일 경로 및 세션 분리
unproven_original_assets: Per-job log retrieval/authorization: no implemented original log endpoint is present in the current FastAPI route set.

Artifact/image upload, content retrieval and cross-owner denial: original OpenAPI defines artifact routes, but those routes are not implemented in the current app and have no accepted endpoint-level tests.
Device/bridge command and telemetry isolation: original OpenAPI bridge/runtime routes are not implemented; no hardware/device access was executed.
Real corporate SSO, deployed TLS/proxy, production project provisioning and operating database/workspace policy are environment acceptance, not established by synthetic local fixtures.

claims_prohibited: A POST 202 response is command acceptance only; it does not prove command application, worker execution, build completion, publication, artifact availability, or device action.
G5 READY means the private workspace is durably prepared only; it is not a job execution state.
No original AT-01..AT-32 is marked executed by this matrix or by G1-G5 partial evidence.
No B03 Temporal/outbox consumer, B04 live SSE/artifact/log delivery, B09 device/bridge, real publisher, external provider or corporate OIDC was exercised.
